current_recommendation.maturity_public_grid_implication: A 220 EUR maturity average is compatible with a 200–250 EUR seasonal working grid if demand supports the high dates; the future grid is not yet approved.

positioning_logic: The local market validates demand but does not justify the premium by heritage alone.
The defensible premium comes from suite volume, privacy, night landscape, reserved wellness and embodied hospitality.
A seasonal range preserves an accessible launch point while monetizing strong dates.
Pricing must be recalibrated after real photography, reviews and observed conversion.
limitations: Documentary sample with prices observed on differing dates and channels; refresh on identical dates and conditions before the 2027 rate grid.
